items.text: The post's frontmatter states it was last updated on 2026-09-21.
As of 2026-09-21, Pulumi's latest stable release is v3.261.0, released 2026-09-02 (at-a-glance table; note this conflicts with v3.263.0 / 2026-09-16 stated at L172 and L203).
As of 2026-09-21, Terraform's latest stable release is v1.16.1, released 2026-09-02 (at-a-glance table; conflicts with v1.16.3 / 2026-09-16 at L173 and L505).
As of 2026-09-21, AWS CDK's latest stable release is v2.268.0, released 2026-09-02 (at-a-glance table; conflicts with v2.270.0 / 2026-09-17 at L174 and L559).
As of 2026-09-21, Kubernetes' latest stable release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
Pulumi supports authoring infrastructure in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, .NET, Java, YAML, and HCL.
Pulumi supports AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and hundreds of other providers.
Pulumi is licensed under Apache-2.0.
Pulumi is best for teams who want flexible, language-agnostic IaC for infrastructure and operations.
Terraform uses HCL, HashiCorp's domain-specific language, as its configuration language.
Terraform supports AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and hundreds of community providers.
Terraform is licensed under BUSL-1.1, which is not an OSI-approved license.
Terraform is best for teams with existing Terraform expertise and established workflows.
AWS CDK supports TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, and Go.
AWS CDK compiles (synthesizes) its programs to CloudFormation templates.
AWS CDK supports AWS only (no other clouds).
AWS CDK is licensed under Apache-2.0.
AWS CDK is best for AWS-focused teams who prefer programming languages over templates.
Kubernetes YAML as an IaC approach uses YAML manifests and works on any Kubernetes cluster.
Kubernetes is licensed under Apache-2.0.
Kubernetes YAML is best for teams managing container-native applications and cloud-native infrastructure.

As of 2026-09-21 (per the updated column header), Azure Bicep's latest stable release is v0.46.1, released 2026-07-30 (unchanged at-a-glance row now under a re-dated header; conflicts with v0.47.16 / 2026-09-08 at L177 and L702).

As of 2026-09-21 (per the updated column header), Crossplane's latest stable release is v2.4.0, released 2026-08-20 (unchanged at-a-glance row now under a re-dated header; conflicts with v2.4.1 / 2026-09-15 at L180 and L854).
The version and release-date figures in the comparison table were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21 and are dated snapshots that will drift.
The pricing-at-a-glance table is based on published pricing as of September 2026.
The company/product env0 has been renamed to "env zero" (env zero is formerly env0).
Spacelift and env zero are managed CI/CD layers that are frequently compared against the core IaC tools in the table.
Spacelift and env zero publish their own pricing tiers, denominated differently from the per-resource pricing in the article's table.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than by seats or resources.
Spacelift's top-end pricing tier is quote-based.
Env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or per environment.
Spacelift's and env zero's pricing figures change often.
Pulumi's latest stable release is v3.263.0, released 2026-09-16 (governance table and Pulumi section).
Pulumi's governing body is Pulumi Corporation.
The Pulumi GitHub repository has roughly 25,700 (~25.7k) stars, measured 2026-09-21.
Terraform's latest stable release is v1.16.3, released 2026-09-16 (governance table and Terraform section).
Terraform's governing body is HashiCorp, which is an IBM company.
The Terraform GitHub repository has roughly 49,700 (~49.7k) stars, measured 2026-09-21.
AWS CDK's latest stable release is v2.270.0, released 2026-09-17 (governance table and CDK section).
AWS CDK's governing body is AWS.
The AWS CDK GitHub repository has roughly 12,900 (~12.9k) stars, measured 2026-09-21.
Azure Bicep is licensed under MIT.
Azure Bicep's governing body is Microsoft.
Azure Bicep's latest stable release is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08.
The Azure Bicep GitHub repository has roughly 3,600 (~3.6k) stars.
Kubernetes' governing body is the CNCF.
The Kubernetes GitHub repository has roughly 127,900 (~127.9k) stars, measured 2026-09-21.
Crossplane is licensed under Apache-2.0.
Crossplane's governing body is the CNCF.
Crossplane's latest stable release is v2.4.1, released 2026-09-15.
The Crossplane GitHub repository has roughly 12,100 (~12.1k) stars, measured 2026-09-21.
OpenTofu is licensed under MPL-2.0.
OpenTofu's governing body is the Linux Foundation.
OpenTofu's latest stable release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19 (as of 2026-09-21).
The OpenTofu GitHub repository has roughly 30,200 (~30.2k) stars, measured 2026-09-21.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager automates the deployment and management of Google Cloud infrastructure resources using Terraform configurations.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager represents Google's modern approach to infrastructure as code.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces (is the successor to) Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager will be fully turned down on June 30, 2027 for any workloads still migrating.
Pulumi Cloud's editions/plans are named Free, Essentials, Pro, and Enterprise.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition includes unlimited stacks and projects.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition includes 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud's Essentials edition starts at $40/month.
Pulumi Cloud's Essentials edition includes 40 credits.
Pulumi Cloud's Essentials edition covers up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Pro edition is priced at $400/month.
Pulumi Cloud's Pro edition includes 400 credits.
Pulumi Cloud's Pro edition covers up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Enterprise edition is custom, contract-priced (no published price).
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources.
HCP Terraform's free tier allows one concurrent run.
Above the free tier, HCP Terraform charges per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Self-hosted Terraform Enterprise is available at custom pricing for larger organizations.
The managed-platform pricing figures in the FAQ reflect published pricing checked on 2026-09-21.
By GitHub stars, Kubernetes leads the broader infrastructure ecosystem (has more stars than every IaC tool listed).
Kubernetes is the de facto container orchestration standard rather than a pure IaC tool.
Among dedicated IaC tools, Terraform remains the most-starred GitHub repository.
By GitHub stars measured 2026-09-21, dedicated IaC tools rank Terraform, then OpenTofu, then Pulumi, then AWS CDK, then Crossplane.
Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption.
Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, and Kubernetes-native infrastructure management, respectively.
